<div class="card-body">
'''Snowtrooper''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ホスの位置以外の位置では戦闘力－1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Snowtrooper-PSA-102220473.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コールド・アサルト・トルーパーは氷点下で活動するよう訓練され、特殊装備を装着している。ブリザード・フォースのスノートルーパーはＡＴ－ＡＴと連係して戦うことが多い。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Snowtrooper.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy only on Hoth. After that, the card can move anywhere. At a location other than a Hoth location, it is power −1.

'''Lore:'''
Cold Assault troopers are trained to operate below freezing and wear special equipment. Blizzard Force’s snowtroopers often fight in coordination with AT-ATs.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Snowtrooper]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
